title: Are the configuration's field names and layout right?
body:
AssemblyAI#27 settled that this specification sets the configuration's field names (your answer to its Q4), and the map left them as the last fog. Rule 33 sets them in five tables: `[limits]`, `[logs]`, `[providers.<provider>]`, `[roles.<role>]` and `[repositories.<name>]`, with every field's type, default and meaning drawn from the decided settings, and rule 34 shows them written out.

Nothing about the settings themselves is new: each meaning and default comes from the cited ticket or from your answers on the 05, 06 and 07 boards. Only the names and their grouping are chosen here.
rec: A, unless a name reads wrongly to you; put any renames in the notes and I will apply them across the documents.
options: A: the names and layout as drafted
B: as drafted, with the renames or regrouping in my notes

title: Accept 09 CLI and configuration?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start 10 Release, install and upgrade. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
